If necessary, take it at bedtime, and as a rule leave an interval of 4 hours between doses.
entries.만 15세 이상은 1회 2포씩, 만 11세 이상~만 15세 미만은 1회: Those aged 15 years and over take 2 sachets at a time, those aged 11 years to under 15 years take 4/3 of a sachet at a time, those aged 8 years to under 11 years take 1 sachet at a time, those aged 5 years to under 8 years take 2/3 of a sachet at a time, those aged 3 years to under 5 years take 1/2 of a sachet at a time, and those aged 1 year to under 3 years take 2/5 of a sachet at a time, 3 times a day.
entries.만 15세 이상은 2포, 만 11세 이상~만 15세 미만은 4/3포, 만: Those aged 15 years and over take 2 sachets, those aged 11 years to under 15 years take 4/3 of a sachet, those aged 7 years to under 11 years take 1 sachet, and those aged 3 years to under 7 years take 2/3 of a sachet. To prevent motion sickness, take one dose 30 minutes before boarding. If an additional dose is needed, take one dose leaving an interval of at least 4 hours, and limit the number of doses to 3 times a day.
entries.만 2세 미만의 소아, 이 약에 과민증 및 경험자, MAO억제제(항우울제: Children under 2 years of age, patients who are hypersensitive to this medicine or have experienced such hypersensitivity, people who are taking MAO inhibitors (antidepressants, antipsychotics, mood regulators, antiparkinsonian agents, etc.) or are within 2 weeks of having stopped them, patients with severe or uncontrolled high blood pressure, and patients with severe acute or chronic kidney disease/renal failure must not take this medicine. Before taking this medicine, people with an allergic constitution, people who have experienced allergic symptoms caused by a medicine (fever, rash, joint pain, asthma, itching, etc.), people with heart disease, glaucoma (eye pain, blurred vision, etc.) or difficulty urinating (passing urine), people with a weak body or a high fever, the elderly, patients with smoking, asthma, chronic bronchitis, emphysema, a cough accompanied by excessive phlegm, a cough that lasts more than 1 week or recurs, a chronic cough, or a cough accompanied by fever and rash or a persistent headache, people in whom symptoms of ischemic colitis (sudden abdominal pain, rectal bleeding, etc.) appear in connection with the pseudoephedrine component, and people who have experienced hypersensitivity or an allergic reaction to Yellow No. 4, Yellow No. 5, Red No. 40 or Yellow No. 203 should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Follow the prescribed dosage and administration carefully. When giving it to a child, administer it under the guidance and supervision of a guardian. If there is no improvement in symptoms after taking it 5 to 6 times, stop taking it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. Drowsiness may occur after taking it, so take care when driving or operating machinery.
entries.만 2세 이하의 젖먹이, 눈 또는 눈주위, 점막(입안, 코안, 질 등),: Do not use it on infants aged 2 years or under, or on the eyes or the area around the eyes, mucous membranes (inside the mouth, inside the nose, the vagina, etc.), the genitals, the external genitalia, or diseased areas with severe eczema, dampness, rawness, cracking or wounds. Before using this medicine, people who have experienced allergic symptoms (rash and reddening from congestion, itching, dermatitis caused by lacquer, etc.), people with an allergic constitution, people whose diseased area is on the face or is extensive, people whose diseased area is festering, people for whom the distinction between eczema and athlete's foot or jock itch (groin ringworm (tinea corporis)) is unclear, and young children should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Use this medicine for external use only and do not take it by mouth. Take care that it does not get into the eyes; if it does, wash immediately with water and be examined by an eye specialist. Clean the diseased area and its surroundings before use. Shake well before use. Spray from a distance of 5 cm from the diseased area. Do not spray continuously on the same area for more than 3 seconds. If there is no improvement in symptoms after using it for about 2 weeks, stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. When using it on a child, use it under the guidance and supervision of a guardian. Follow the prescribed dosage and administration carefully.
entries.만 3개월 미만의 젖먹이는 이 약을 복용하지 마십시오.이 약을 복용하기: Infants under 3 months of age must not take this medicine. Before taking this medicine, women who are pregnant or may be pregnant and people who have experienced hypersensitivity or an allergic reaction to caramel should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Follow the prescribed dosage and administration carefully. When giving it to a child, administer it under the guidance and supervision of a guardian. If there is no improvement in symptoms after taking it for about 2 weeks, stop taking it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.만 7세 이상 및 성인은 1회 1번씩, 1일 2회 양쪽 코 안에 뿌리십시: Those aged 7 years and over and adults spray once at a time into both nostrils, twice a day. Use it at intervals of 10 to 12 hours. Do not exceed 2 doses in 24 hours.
entries.만 7세 이하의 어린이는 이 약을 복용하지 마십시오.이 약을 복용하기 전: Children aged 7 years or under must not take this medicine. Before taking this medicine, patients with an allergic constitution and women who are pregnant or may be pregnant should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Follow the prescribed dosage and administration carefully. If there is no improvement in symptoms after taking it for about 2 weeks, stop taking it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.만 8세 이상은 1회 10 mL씩, 만 24개월 이상~만 8세 미만 1회: Those aged 8 years and over take 10 mL at a time, those aged 24 months to under 8 years take 5 mL at a time, and those aged 12 months to under 24 months take 2.5 mL at a time, twice a day.

entries.멀미의 예방에는 승차 30분에서 1시간 전에 성인 및 만 15세 이상은: To prevent motion sickness, take the medicine 30 minutes to 1 hour before boarding: adults and those aged 15 years and over take 1 tablet at a time, those aged 11 years to under 15 years take 2/3 of a tablet at a time, and those aged 8 years to under 11 years take 1/2 of a tablet at a time. entries.바르비탈계 약물, 삼환계 항우울제, 알코올, 다른 소염(항염)진통제와 함: Do not take this medicine together with barbiturates, tricyclic antidepressants, alcohol or other anti-inflammatory analgesics. If you take it together with warfarin or flucloxacillin, consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.발적, 부종, 자극감, 출혈 등이 나타나는 경우 사용을 즉각 중지하고 의: If redness, swelling, a feeling of irritation, bleeding or the like occurs, stop using the medicine immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.발진 및 발적, 부종, 자극감, 가려움 등이 나타나는 경우 이 약의 사용: If rash and redness, swelling, a feeling of irritation, itching or the like occurs, stop using this medicine immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. This medicine contains benzalkonium chloride, so it may cause bronchospasm.
entries.발진, 발적(충혈되어 붉어짐), 가려움, 부기 등이 나타나는 경우 사용을: If rash, redness (congested and reddened skin), itching, swelling or the like occurs, stop using the medicine immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.

entries.발진·발적, 종창, 가려움, 통증, 부종 등이 나타나는 경우 사용을 즉각: If rash and redness, swelling of the tissue, itching, pain, edema or the like occurs, stop using the medicine immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.배변 습관에 갑작스러운 변화, 묽은 변, 설사가 나타나는 경우 복용을 즉: If a sudden change in bowel habits, loose stools or diarrhea occurs, stop taking the medicine immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. Belching, cramping abdominal discomfort and, occasionally, rumbling in the abdomen, a feeling of abdominal fullness, abdominal pain, loss of appetite, nausea and vomiting may occur.

Gastrointestinal adverse reactions, allergic reactions, angioedema, difficulty breathing, rash, erythematous rash, urticaria, pruritus (itching), hyperkalemia, hypokalemia, headache, abdominal pain, diarrhea, vomiting, nausea, indigestion, abdominal distension, rumbling in the abdomen (the sound of gas in the bowel), flatulence (abdominal distension), anal discomfort and peripheral edema (swelling) may occur.
entries.붉은반점, 설사, 심장박동정지, 중추신경계기능저하, 복부불쾌감, 변비,: If red spots, diarrhea, cardiac arrest, depressed central nervous system function, abdominal discomfort, constipation, loss of appetite, rash or the like occurs, stop taking the medicine immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.

Before using this medicine, people who have experienced allergic symptoms to a medicine or cosmetic (rash, redness, itching, dermatitis caused by lacquer, etc.), people with an allergic constitution, patients with severe dampness (moistness) or inflammation, and infants and young children should consult a doctor or pharmacist. entries.설사, 구역, 구토, 배 아픔, 변비, 가슴앓이, 위부불쾌감, 가려움,: If diarrhea, nausea, vomiting, stomach ache, constipation, heartburn, stomach discomfort, itching, rash, general malaise, dizziness, calcification of gallstones, increases in liver enzyme values (ALT, ALP, AST, γ-GT), a decrease in white blood cells, or interstitial pneumonia accompanied by fever, coughing, difficulty breathing and abnormal chest X-ray findings occurs, stop taking the medicine immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.성인 및 12세 이상은 1회 2~4번, 6세이상 12세미만은 1회 2번,: Adults and those aged 12 years and over spray 2 to 4 sprays at a time, and those aged 6 years to under 12 years spray 2 sprays at a time, 2 to 6 times a day.
entries.성인 및 6세 이상의 소아는 1일 1회 1정(10 mg)을 취침 전에 복: Adults and children aged 6 years and over take 1 tablet (10 mg) once a day before bedtime, and patients who are sensitive to adverse reactions take 1/2 tablet (5 mg) in divided doses in the morning and in the evening. Increase or decrease the dose as appropriate according to age and symptoms. In patients with moderate to severe (severe symptoms) renal impairment the dosing interval must be adjusted according to the patient's renal function, and in child patients with renal impairment the dose must be adjusted individually taking into account the patient's renal clearance and body weight, so refer to the approved product information for details.
entries.성인 및 만 2세 이상의 소아는 상처 및 주변 피부에 1일 수회 적용하여: Adults and children aged 2 years and over apply it to the wound and the surrounding skin several times a day and massage it in lightly. For hypertrophic scars, adults may apply it thickly the day before and fix it with a bandage, leaving it on for one night.
entries.성인에서 복통 및 복부팽만, 설사, 구역, 흔하지 않게 구토, 긴급한 배: In adults, if abdominal pain and abdominal distension, diarrhea or nausea occurs, uncommonly vomiting, urgent bowel movements or fecal incontinence occurs, electrolyte disturbances (hyponatremia, hypokalemia) and dehydration or erythema occurs at an unknown frequency, particularly in the elderly, or very rarely hypersensitivity reactions (itching, rash, facial edema, angioedema, urticaria, anaphylaxis, shock) occur, stop taking the medicine immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. In children, if abdominal pain, diarrhea and pain around the anus caused by diarrhea occurs, uncommonly vomiting, abdominal distension or nausea occurs, or hypersensitivity reactions (hypersensitivity, angioedema, urticaria, rash, itching) occur at an unknown frequency, stop taking the medicine immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. Hypersensitivity reactions to macrogol (polyethylene glycol) (hypersensitivity, angioedema, urticaria, rash, itching, erythema) may occur.
entries.성인은 1회 1 g씩 1일 3회, 6세 이상 소아는 1회 1 g씩 1일: Adults take 1 g at a time 3 times a day, and children aged 6 years and over take 1 g at a time twice a day. Do not take it for 4 weeks or longer.
entries.성인은 1회 1정(100 mg)씩, 1일 1회 연속 6일간 취침 시 질내: Adults insert 1 tablet (100 mg) at a time deep into the vagina at bedtime, once a day for 6 consecutive days. As short-term therapy, adults insert 2 tablets (200 mg) at a time deep into the vagina at bedtime, once a day for 3 consecutive days.
entries.성인은 1회 1캡슐(300 mg)을 1일 2~3회 복용합니다.급성 호흡기: Adults take 1 capsule (300 mg) at a time, 2 to 3 times a day. When taking it for an acute respiratory disease, do not take it continuously for 10 days or longer.

Take it after meals for esophagitis and between meals for other indications. Children aged 24 months and over take 2 to 3 sachets (6 to 9 g) a day in 3 divided doses for 3 days, and then 2 sachets (6 g) a day in 3 divided doses for the following 4 days.
Adults take 2 tablets at a time, 3 times a day before meals or between meals.
